searchText: Testing IPv6 only support in Teku and struggling to find IPv6 peers on mainnet? Is that normal? We saw the same basically and didn't get around to fixing it properly, we wanted to make all of our bootnodes dual stack but ran into issues in docker/cloud provider not giving us reserved ipv6. I think lighthouse or someone ran a pure v6 bootnode though? Thanks, looks like the lighthouse bootnodes are dual stack, hmm will debug to see what is wrong Looks like lighthouse bootnodes only expose the udp port, so can't be used as peers themselves, if anybody is connected to an ipv6 peer, would appreciate if they can send across the multiaddr, so can give it a try to connect to it as a static peer
